change: Add a Match them up mode to the eigenvalue detective

mutations.name: the trace is taken with the wrong sign
det A is taken as ad + bc
a matrix's match is read from the wrong end of the order
a root counted twice is listed as none
the slip says the trace matches when the det does
mutations.find: const off = this.tr(B)===t ? 'the trace matches, but det A does not' : this.det(B)===D ?
mutations.replace: const off = this.det(B)===D ? 'the trace matches, but det A does not' : this.tr(B)===t ?

mutations.name: the slip names the polynomial picked as the right one
a zero det is not told
shared traces are told as shared dets
mutations.find: for(let i=0;i<4;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<4;j++) if(this.det(M[i])===this.det(M[j])) out.push([i,j]);
mutations.replace: for(let i=0;i<4;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<4;j++) if(this.tr(M[i])===this.tr(M[j])) out.push([i,j]);

mutations.name: the curves are drawn upside down
the eigenvalue dots are put on the curve's bottom
the ring goes on the right polynomial
a fix counts as a first check
match them up is not offered as a tab
mutations.find: ,['match','🧩 Match them up','See four matrices and four polynomials, and match each matrix to its det(A − λI)']]
